newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Sanmao net down on falling textile prices.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Sanmao net down on falling textile prices.

text.p: Shanghai Sanmao Textile Co Ltd recorded net profit of 5.591 million yuan in 1996 under international accounting standards, compared with 8.442 million in 1995, the company said on Sunday.
The drop in profits was due to falling prices in the textile market and continued high prices for raw materials, according to the company's annual report published in the Shanghai Securities News.
Under Chinese accounting standards, net profit plunged 49.43 percent to 10.240 million yuan for 1996, compared with 20.250 million in 1995, the report said.
Despite the difficult operating environment in 1996, the firm expanded its line of woollen textiles, increased sales, improved brand-name recognition and upgraded technology, it said.
The board of directors have proposed a one-for-10 bonus share issue, pending approval at a shareholders meeting on May 28, the report said.
